title: anon left open (vsftpd) — review required
description: anon runs with an open setting: anonymous_enables*=s*YES. Open binds, trust auth, and disabled protections expose the service to unauthenticated networks. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms isolation or hardens it.
remediation: Apply NO plus local auth and verify from an untrusted network.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of network isolation.
